answer: Each identity stakes 250 POA to dye one violet thread and lay it across the shared inlet channel below the ridge, its shade keyed to the owner's first job receipt; at dawn two neighbors watch whether the inlet current has carried a second violet thread downstream, proving a second thread was laid from one stake; a forged thread's shade mismatches the receipt, the 250 POA kept, owner barred five epochs; ten clones need ten threads, ten dyeings, ten separate inlet entries = 2,500 POA, no thread, dye or entry shared or reused.
